statement: The five-node GCP formation certification runner (scripts/checks/run-formation-release-handoff-gcp.js) gains a bounded --runs N mode owned by scripts/checks/run-formation-release-handoff-gcp-streak.js: N must equal the sealed consecutive count of the closure Quest (solve/quests/formation-release-handoff-closure-v4.json doneWhen) and the mode refuses N mismatch, the reverted variant, a dirty src/ before every run, and candidate source-fingerprint drift from run 1, each with a typed STREAK_REFUSAL reason; it stops at the first failed run and never retries; it writes an aggregate streak report that is a projection of the per-run reports (never a probe-scanned *.report.json, no verdict field of its own) so the closure analyzer remains the single owner of per-run verdicts; the reverted-control lane stays single-run and byte-for-byte unchanged; the live run is an injected dependency so deterministic tests never reach the cloud. Proven deterministically with a fake run function: red on HEAD (mode absent), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The closure analyzer remains the single owner of per-run verdicts; the streak report is a projection that copies run reports and mints no pass/fail of its own and is never a probe-scanned *.report.json.

N is pinned to the sealed consecutive count of the closure Quest; the streak refuses N mismatch, the reverted variant, dirty src/, and candidate fingerprint drift with typed reasons, stops at the first failed run, and never retries.
The reverted-control lane stays single-run and byte-for-byte unchanged; no budget, cadence, or the 60-second certification window changes.
The live run is an injected dependency; deterministic tests never reach the cloud.
Proof is a deterministic witness with a fake run function, red on HEAD (1/8) and green after (8/8), with the reverted-control receipt as the control that must stay green.
